src: Shank you soooo much...
Oh Millja...
My friend, your next drink is on me.
*sniff*
Shank you. Your a gooood one.
Heard you've been crying for a week now.
Please, tell me a bit about Millja.
Oh... She wash de cutesht liddle wormy out here.
I alwaysh carrid her round.
An when she wash hungry... I'd jus...
I'd puke... and she ate it.
And she showed me her beautiful littl teethies.
Like... she's smiling.
Sho happy and cute.
Bwawawaaa...
*gulp*
But then... you kno... she's a curious one.
Alwaysh nosing aroun'.
An she went cho she turret.
An hen... she... she... never came back...
Buhuhu
*sniff*
And now?
You know yourself that you can't go on like this, right?
You're right.
I need to change shomethin.
I'm goin' to revenge Millja.
You know what? Go for it.
Fuck no. The guards will kill you.
That's a really bad idea.
But then... what should I do?
Get another Fleshworm.
You want me to replashe Millja?
But there'sh noone else out there like her.
Millja was so *hick* unique.
An you jus wand me to forget? To take another one?
Your no better than the turret that shot her.
Fuck you.
I don't really have an answer.
I've only known you for a couple of minutes, you know.
It's not like I'd know what would help you get over it.
Do things that make you happy. Keep busy. Make your head free.
Maybe you'll find someone out there, to fill a bit of that gap Millja left.
Just give yourself time.
You kno what? You're right.
I'll stop drinking for now.
Shank you sooooo much.
I heard your story from the guards.
Sho what?
I think I can help you.
How? Millja ish gone. An nothin' willl bring her back.
I'm sho alone now.
All alone.
Millja...
*gulp*
Jusss leawe me awone!
Don wanna talk.
Bwawawaaa...
That was so good.
I should do this more often.
Oh, and since you helped me so much...
Take this.
Thank you so much.
I wont touch the booze again... at least for a couple of days.
I'm sure Millja is showing her smile to the Titans now.
Are you happy to see me, or do you have a fleshworm in your pants?
For me it's both.
Do you still feel sad about Millja?
Milla? Who's that?
Nard is right. Shut up.
We're having a moment here.
Oh Millja...
Sometimes I wonder: Am I always right, or are the others always wrong?
Do you ever wonder where the Flesh Titans come from?
Hey, you're looking hot.
Do not listen to the Historian.
This place is sacred. Watch your fucking language.
We are like one big, fleshy family.
I recently met a follower of the Machines. Such a moron.
You anger one of us, you anger all of us.
The Flesh Titans are like our brothers and sisters. And fathers and mothers. And masters.
The High Priest is a wise man.
Many people come here to talk to the High Priest.
The Titans bless you, my child.
The what?
The Flesh Titans.
The masters of these places.
OUR masters.
Who are you, that you don't know of them?
I won't tell you.
How deviant.
But if the Titans gave me this challenge, I will see it through.
Nobody.
How humble.
You must be blessed by them, even if you do not know.
**forename**.
Very well. It is a pleasure to meet you.
I don't need their blessing.
A lost soul.
I pity you.
But you are not yet abandoned.
Let me help you find back to the flock.
Who are you?
I won't tell you.
How deviant.
But if the Titans gave me this challenge, I will see it through.
Nobody.
At least you have the humility to see that.
**forename**.
Very well. It is a pleasure to meet you.
Titans? Like that Fleshkraken?
You have met one of them?
How lucky.
Who are you, blessed one?
Nobody.
A humble soul, I see.
**forename**.
Very well. It is a pleasure to meet you.
Thanks, I guess.
You do not appear to be very devout.
Who might you be?
Nobody.
A humble soul, I see.
You would do well to show more respect to the Titans.
I will.
Very good.
I already do.
But you don't look like a Titan.
Fair enough.
Why should I?
The Titans are the proof of life to be.
Where they walk, the soil is blessed.
And gives us our daily meat.
**forename**.
Very well. It is a pleasure to meet you.
Not yet.
Trouble has come up.
The Titan's heart has been stolen, and its guarding priest has been killed.
Presumably by the godhunters.
Until this situation is resolved, I am in no state to continue with you.
Oh. I see.
Good luck.
Titans bless us.
Maybe I can help?
Maybe this is the quest the Titans intended for you from the very beginning.
I'd send you out to retrieve the heart.
But it is too large, even for one of your stature.
So? What should I do?
Worry not.
Inside its heart you shall find the seedling of a Titan.
Not its child, but its source.
Bring me this, and it shall grow back to former glory.
Ok. Got it.
I'm on my way.
Take this. It will help you.
And where should I look for that heart?
You should try the prison of the Godhunters, north of here.
But be careful. It is not without danger to enter.
Even after proving yourself to the Titans already.
You are a true believer.
You are indeed blessed by the Titans.
They must have sent you, knowing this would happen.
We checked out your report, and it sadly appears to be true.
Almost. Something quite worrying has come up.
And it's keeping us very occupied.
I'm back.
And it's as we were told.
The Priest of the Heart was killed and dismembered.
His blood was everywhere.
He managed to crawl away a bit. But it was too late.
The Godhunters?
The Godhunters.
Shit!
Yeah.
And they've stolen the heart.
Fuck...
You did well. Thank you.
I'm sorry.
You'll have to wait until this mess is sorted out.
The Priest of the Heart was killed in front of the pedestal.
Whoever did this also took his belongings.
But it doesn't look like the Godhunters did it.
Not the Godhunters?
No. They would have at least made a show of his body.
This was much more straight forward.
Then the heart...?
It's gone.
Without the priest to guard it, the Godhunters must have used the moment to snatch it.
How horrible.
Almost. We are still inquiring about the priest of the heart.
I'm sorry, but the Titan's Heart has been stolen.
I don't even know where to start.
Right, right.
Here, take this. It might aid you.
What is this?
It will give you entrance to the Godhunters prison.
Be careful. It is a dangerous place.
Titans forgive me.
I wished to give you the key to the Godhunters prison.
But it appears to have left my possession.
It must be that the Titans are giving you one more challenge to overcome.
What am I supposed to do?
I gave you the key to the prison of the Godhunters.
You should start looking there.
The prison of the Godhunters is too dangerous for me.
The Titans are watching over you.
I am sure of your success.
Here it is.
You have done it.
Marvellous.
You must be a holy one, chosen by the Titans.
Please hand the seedling over to me.
We will return it to where it belongs.
It's great to see you, I need to talk to you.
You remember how I told you I could not share the secret of this place with you?
Well, to my shame it turns out I acted foolishly.
The key was in my other pocket, and I just forgot to check.
I deeply apologize.
Here, take this, and see for yourself what this place once used to be.
Oh blessed one, I need to talk to you.
Oh **forename**, I need to talk to you.
What would you like to talk about?
What is this place?
We stand within the holy ruins of New Delphi.
A place so old even the Historian, down there in his hut, is struggling to fathom them.
Even then, the only history which matters is that of the Sleeper.
He chose this as his resting place.
So we gather around him, and pray to him.
May he bless us.
Is there something else you would like to hear about?
Who are you?
I am the High Priest of New Delphi.
I dispense the will of the Titans.
And serve as a connection between them and all other people.
As such I have discarded my own identity.
All I am now is a vessel for the masters.
Praise the flesh.
Apparently you're hiding something about this place.
Tell me the secret of New Delphi.
I heard something about becoming a pilgrim?
You wish to prove your devotion to the Masters, don't you?
About my pilgrimage...
The priest at Titans Heart has been killed.
Are we ready now?
About the seedling...
I have found the seedling.
What's the secret you didn't want to tell me before?
Have I proven my worth now?
There is one final step.
Go and pray to the sleeper.
What was I supposed to do again?
The final step on your path to become a true believer.
Go and pray to the sleeper.
I have done my prayers.
Well done.
You have more than proven yourself.
Take this, and be safe in the knowledge, that the Titans love you as much as you love them.
Blessed One!
What a pleasure to see you again, **forename**.
Some time ago we found the body of a Titan.
We took it apart and enshrined the parts all over.
So people everywhere could see the wonders of the Titans in their glory.
Go on a pilgrimage and meet the guardians to the shrines of the Head, the Guts and the Heart.
Prove yourself to them, and they will give you a sigil of approval.
Are you ready for this task?
No. This sounds too bothersome.
I knew this would be your answer.
Talk to me again when you wish to prove your devotion.
Of course!
Great.
The first shrine, the Titans Head, is in the mountains south of here.
I was born ready.
Do you mean these sigils?
You already collected them?
How wonderful.
I did not expect this.
You must be blessed by the Titans.
Though this does come as a surprise.
I need to prepare some things.
Let us talk about this again next time you come to New Delphi.
You truly are blessed.
You have yet to receive the first sigil, at Titan's Head.
You will receive the second sigil at Titans Guts, southeast of here.
The last sigil can be gotten at Titans Heart.
Just go eastwards from here to find it.
You have returned.
And it seems successfully so.
I can feel the Titans growing inside you.
